record.bible_text: <FO><FO>Shiggaion<WH07692> of David<WH01732>, which he sang<WH07891><WTH8804> unto the LORD<WH03068>, concerning the words<WH01697> of Cush<WH03568> the Benjamite<WH01121><WH01145>.<Fo><Fo> O LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>, in thee do I put my trust<WH02620><WTH8804>: save<WH03467><WTH8685> me from all them that persecute<WH07291><WTH8802> me, and deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> me: <RF>words: or, business<Rf>

Lest he tear<WH02963><WTH8799> my soul<WH05315> like a lion<WH0738>, rending <FI>it<Fi> in pieces<WH06561><WTH8802>, while <FI>there is<Fi> none to deliver<WH05337><WTH8688>. <RF>none...: Heb. not a deliverer<Rf>
O LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>, if I have done<WH06213><WTH8804> this; if there be<WH03426> iniquity<WH05766> in my hands<WH03709>;

If I have rewarded<WH01580><WTH8804> evil<WH07451> unto him that was at peace<WH07999><WTH8802> with me; (yea, I have delivered<WH02502><WTH8762> him that without cause<WH07387> is mine enemy<WH06887><WTH8802>:)

Let the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> persecute<WH07291><WTH8762> my soul<WH05315>, and take<WH05381><WTH8686> <FI>it<Fi> ; yea, let him tread down<WH07429><WTH8799> my life<WH02416> upon the earth<WH0776>, and lay<WH07931><WTH8686> mine honour<WH03519> in the dust<WH06083>. Selah<WH05542>.

Arise<WH06965><WTH8798>, O LORD<WH03068>, in thine anger<WH0639>, lift up<WH05375><WTH8734> thyself because of the rage<WH05678> of mine enemies<WH06887><WTH8802>: and awake<WH05782><WTH8798> for me <FI>to<Fi>  the judgment<WH04941> <FI>that<Fi> thou hast commanded<WH06680><WTH8765>.
So shall the congregation<WH05712> of the people<WH03816> compass thee about<WH05437><WTH8779>: for their sakes therefore return<WH07725><WTH8798> thou on high<WH04791>.

The LORD<WH03068> shall judge<WH01777><WTH8799> the people<WH05971>: judge<WH08199><WTH8798> me, O LORD<WH03068>, according to my righteousness<WH06664>, and according to mine integrity<WH08537> <FI>that is<Fi> in me.

Oh let the wickedness<WH07451> of the wicked<WH07563> come to an end<WH01584><WTH8799>; but establish<WH03559><WTH8787> the just<WH06662>: for the righteous<WH06662> God<WH0430> trieth<WH0974><WTH8802> the hearts<WH03826> and reins<WH03629>.<CM>
My defence<WH04043> <FI>is<Fi> of God<WH0430>, which saveth<WH03467><WTH8688> the upright<WH03477> in heart<WH03820>. <RF>My...: Heb. My buckler is upon God<Rf>
God<WH0430> judgeth<WH08199><WTH8802> the righteous<WH06662>, and God<WH0410> is angry<WH02194><WTH8802> <FI>with the wicked<Fi> every day<WH03117>. <RF>judgeth...: or, is a righteous judge<Rf>
If he turn<WH07725><WTH8799> not, he will whet<WH03913><WTH8799> his sword<WH02719>; he hath bent<WH01869><WTH8804> his bow<WH07198>, and made it ready<WH03559><WTH8787>.
He hath also prepared<WH03559><WTH8689> for him the instruments<WH03627> of death<WH04194>; he ordaineth<WH06466><WTH8799> his arrows<WH02671> against the persecutors<WH01814><WTH8801>.
Behold, he travaileth<WH02254><WTH8762> with iniquity<WH0205>, and hath conceived<WH02029><WTH8804> mischief<WH05999>, and brought forth<WH03205><WTH8804> falsehood<WH08267>.

He made<WH03738><WTH8804> a pit<WH0953>, and digged<WH02658><WTH8799> it, and is fallen<WH05307><WTH8799> into the ditch<WH07845> <FI>which<Fi> he made<WH06466><WTH8799>. <RF>He made a pit: Heb. He hath digged a pit<Rf>
His mischief<WH05999> shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> upon his own head<WH07218>, and his violent<WH02555> dealing shall come down<WH03381><WTH8799> upon his own pate<WH06936>.
I will praise<WH03034><WTH8686> the LORD<WH03068> according to his righteousness<WH06664>: and will sing praise<WH02167><WTH8762> to the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068> most high<WH05945>.<CM>
